title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description: Who we are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What you will do Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team. Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers Who you are We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel. Typically, your profile will look like this: Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it What makes this exciting You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. What the process will look like We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP. Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage: Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics Offer, contract signing and onboarding Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
